system_description.narrative_title: US–China strategic-economic competition reshaping trade, tech and security
system_description.narrative_summary: News across this window coalesces around a single, dominant story: accelerating strategic and economic competition between the United States (and its Western partners) and China, expressed through high-profile diplomacy, reciprocal trade and tech measures, and concurrent domestic stimulus and industrial expansion inside China. The summit theatrics and tariff/AI talks mask persistent frictions—export controls, critical-minerals and battery disputes, auto-market competition, and security moves in Asia—that produce feedbacks across markets, supply chains, corporate strategies and regional stability. Short-term market signals (earnings, stock moves) and firm-level disruptions (auto suppliers, semiconductors, EV makers) are tightly coupled to policy instruments (tariffs, subsidies, export controls) and geopolitical maneuvers (military presence, Taiwan tensions).
system_description.scope: Bilateral US–China geopolitical and economic interactions and their immediate global spillovers: trade measures, export controls, AI/tech dialogues, Chinese domestic stimulus and industrial policy, firm- and market-level impacts, and regional security moves in East and Southeast Asia.
system_description.super_system: Global political-economic order (international system of states, trade regimes, global markets and security architecture)
adjacent_subsystems: Global supply chains & manufacturing (semiconductors, batteries, autos)
Regional security in East and Southeast Asia (Taiwan, South China Sea, military presence)
Western trade and industrial policy coordination (EU, US export controls, tariffs)

variables.name: Strategic-economic competition intensity
variables.description: Measures the overall intensity of strategic and economic rivalry expressed through coordinated state actions and countermoves across policy, commerce and security domains.

variables.name: Tariff and trade barrier level
variables.description: Measures the aggregate level and strictness of tariffs, quotas and formal trade barriers applied across bilateral and multilateral trade channels.

variables.name: Export control and restriction intensity
variables.description: Measures the scope and severity of controls on exports of technologies, inputs and dual‑use goods that restrict cross‑border transfers.

variables.name: Industrial subsidy and support scale
variables.description: Measures the magnitude and breadth of direct and indirect fiscal measures (subsidies, tax incentives, purchase guarantees) supporting targeted industries.

variables.name: Critical materials supply reliability
variables.description: Measures the availability, diversification and reliability of upstream supplies of key raw materials and minerals used in advanced industries.

variables.name: Semiconductor supply‑chain resilience
variables.description: Measures the capacity of semiconductor production and logistics networks to absorb shocks and meet demand without major disruption.

variables.name: Automotive and EV market competition intensity
variables.description: Measures the degree of competitive pressure, market entry and pricing contestation in passenger vehicle and electric vehicle markets globally.

variables.name: Cross‑border capital and investment flows
variables.description: Measures the volume and directional intensity of cross‑border investments, acquisitions and capital movements between jurisdictions.

variables.name: Technology development and diffusion rate
variables.description: Measures the pace at which new technologies are developed, commercialized and diffused across firms and markets.

variables.name: AI and tech regulatory coordination
variables.description: Measures the degree of institutional coordination and alignment across regulatory frameworks governing artificial intelligence and advanced technologies.

variables.name: Market sentiment and volatility
variables.description: Measures prevailing investor and market participant perceptions and the short‑term volatility reflecting confidence and risk assessment.

variables.name: Military and regional security tension
variables.description: Measures the level of military deployments, maneuvers and security incidents that raise regional geopolitical tension and risk.

variables.name: Supply‑chain disruption frequency
variables.description: Measures the frequency and severity of material interruptions, bottlenecks and stoppages across critical global supply chains.

variables.name: Firm localization vs globalization balance
variables.description: Measures the aggregate tendency of firms to relocate, near‑shore or diversify production versus maintaining integrated global production footprints.

variables.name: Energy and input cost pressure
variables.description: Measures the level and volatility of energy and key input costs that influence production economics across sectors.

variables.name: Trade and regulatory fragmentation
variables.description: Measures the degree to which trade rules, standards and regulatory regimes are diverging or decoupling across blocs and jurisdictions.

catalysts.title: Follow-up Trump–Xi meetings
catalysts.description: Two additional Trump–Xi meetings pledged after the recent summit, likely to revisit tariffs, AI dialogue and trade/security frictions.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Donald Trump and Xi Jinping to meet twice more' and 'U.S., China Agree to Trim Tariffs, Start AI Dialogue.'

catalysts.title: Implementation of agreed $60bn tariff cuts
catalysts.description: Rollout or phasing-in of agreed tariff reductions on ~$60 billion of goods between the U.S. and China, affecting trade flows and rules.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'U.S., China Agree to Trim Tariffs' and 'China, US pledge tariff cuts on $60 billion of goods.'

catalysts.title: U.S. slowdown of aircraft‑part exports to China
catalysts.description: U.S. administrative slowdowns and tighter approvals for aircraft-part exports to China as leverage in trade negotiations.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'EXCLUSIVE: US slows aircraft-part exports to China as Trump seeks leverage in trade negotiations.'

catalysts.title: Expansion of Chinese military presence in Southeast Asia
catalysts.description: New Chinese joint military/support facilities and deployments in Southeast Asia (e.g., Laos) increasing regional force projection and basing.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'China opens rare joint military support centre in Laos' and 'China carves new military presence in Southeast Asian neighbour.'

catalysts.title: Escalating maritime confrontations near Taiwan
catalysts.description: Increased maritime encounters and coastal/naval deployments around Taiwan and adjacent waters, involving regional states' responses.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Philippines sends largest ship, aircraft to drive away Chinese vessel' and 'Xi hardens Taiwan warning.'

catalysts.title: China monetary easing and mortgage-subsidy stimulus
catalysts.description: PBoC rate cut and targeted mortgage subsidies to support growth, influencing competitiveness and domestic demand.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'China unveils rate cut, mortgage subsidies to spur growth' and 'China Offers Subsidies on Some Residential Mortgages.'

catalysts.title: Prolonged DRAM/Memory demand and backlog
catalysts.description: Micron's strong earnings and forecasts point to a sustained memory shortage and elevated demand through 2028, shaping capacity plans.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Micron Profit, Revenue Surge as Memory Crunch Looks to Last Through 2028' and 'Micron... backlog swells.'

catalysts.title: Chinese EV export surge and battery investments in Europe
catalysts.description: Rising Chinese EV exports and battery FDI into Europe (e.g., BYD exports, Gotion investment) intensify competitive pressure in auto markets.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'China's BYD sales rise in September as export boom sustains momentum' and 'China's Gotion invests $1.25 billion in Volkswagen battery plant in Spain.'

catalysts.title: Continued Japanese corporate exits from China
catalysts.description: Record-number exits by Japanese firms from China accelerate supply‑chain relocation and production diversification away from China.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Japanese companies exit China in record numbers.'

catalysts.title: EU regulatory/curb deliberations and possible Chinese retaliation
catalysts.description: EU consideration of measures targeting Chinese trade/industry and Beijing's stated readiness to respond may spur reciprocal policies and trade friction.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'China vows response if EU introduces moves targeting Chinese trade' and 'China driving worrying rise in EU imports, Commission official says.'

catalysts.title: Ongoing Taiwan–U.S. arms sales consultations
catalysts.description: Continuous talks between Taiwan and the U.S. over arms sales, which could produce announcements or deliveries that affect regional deterrence.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Taiwan says it is in continuous talks with US about arms sales.'
